In compliance with the directions of the Commission, the petitioner has filed additional information and has served copies on the respondents. None of the respondents have filed replies to the petition. Taking into consideration the submissions and the documents available on record, we proceed to consider the claims of the petitioner and determine the tariff in respect of this generating station for the period 2014-19.
